description.la: Septem exercitia spiritualia: baptismi renovatio, conversio, sponsalia, professionis renovatio, exercitium amoris, laus et gratiarum actio, reparatio et praeparatio ad mortem.
description.en-US: Seven devotional exercises of Gertrude of Helfta: renewal of baptismal innocence, conversion, spiritual espousals, renewal of religious profession, the exercise of love, praise and thanksgiving, reparation and preparation for death.
description.pt-BR: Sete exercícios de piedade de Gertrudes de Helfta: renovação da inocência batismal, conversão, desposatório espiritual, renovação da profissão religiosa, exercício de amor, louvor e ação de graças, reparação e preparação para a morte.

sources.edition: The Exercises of St. Gertrude, tr. Thomas Alder Pope, London: Burns Oates & Washbourne, 1921 (with Guéranger's preface).
sources.description: Internet Archive OCR of the 1921 translation made from the Latin; running heads, page numbers and scripture-reference footnotes removed, lost drop capitals restored by hand rules (research/sourcing/_scripts/gertrude_exercitia.py). The Latin original (Solesmes 1875) was not found as text online, so there is no la folder.
sources.tierEvidence: English translation published 1921; OCR from the Internet Archive.

title.en-US: First Exercise: The Renewal of Baptismal Innocence
